question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH period_orders AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01' THEN 'January–June 2025'
      WHEN ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' THEN 'July–December 2025'
    END AS reporting_period,
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT reporting_period, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customer_count
FROM period_orders
WHERE order_count >= 2
GROUP BY reporting_period
ORDER BY reporting_period
action.metrics: Repeat customers = distinct customers with at least two recorded orders in that reporting period; all recorded orders are counted regardless of status.

action.answer: Among customers with recorded orders in each respective half of 2025, repeat customers—distinct customers with at least two orders within that half—numbered 95,048 in January–June and 96,514 in July–December. July–December had more repeat customers, by 1,466. Repeat status was evaluated separately within each half; all recorded orders were counted regardless of status.
